target_customer: Developers building LLM applications who want logs and evals without code changes
problem: Teams lack easy insight into how their LLM calls perform. Sublingual offered a pip install tool (subl) that captures inputs, outputs and server calls locally with no code changes.
business_model: Developer tool, open source core, monetization not found

founders.name: Matthew Tang
founders.background_notes: Per YC launch post: ML on TikTok recommendation and ads, LLM research at Nextdoor. Education not listed.

founders.name: Dylan Bowman
founders.background_notes: Per YC launch post: UIUC Kang Lab affiliation and LLM research in defense contracting. Education not listed.

competitors.name: Langfuse
competitors.what: Open source LLM tracing, evals, prompt management and datasets

competitors.name: Confident AI
competitors.what: Open source evaluation framework for LLM apps, launched on HN in the same YC batch

technical_complexity.rationale: Capturing LLM calls without code changes needs instrumentation of Python runtimes, a local log store and eval tooling, moderate for two engineers in 2025.

defensibility.rationale: Open source tool in a crowded observability and evals category, with several funded rivals and no stated data or integration moat.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: The category consolidated in 2025 and 2026, for example Humanloop's team joined Anthropic and its platform sunset in September 2025 per a search report. No source ties this to Sublingual.

market_need_then: LLM app teams needed observability and evals, shown by multiple funded entrants. The founders pitched it as evals for lazy developers.

branding.domain_note: Uses sublingual.ai, the exact name on an .ai domain; no purchase history found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Playful pitch: LLM evals for lazy devs; CLI named subl

brand_strength.rationale: Memorable tagline and short CLI command, but no press or community evidence found. The YC directory description (daily productivity tracker) disagrees with the product.

outcome_analysis: YC lists Sublingual as inactive and no shutdown notice or post-mortem was found, so the cause is not public. A third-party dead startups page speculates about crowding from funded rivals but cites no source, so it is not used. The company sold into a crowded LLM evals market with a two person team and about 500 thousand dollars reported.
notes: Website sublingual.ai is a minimal landing page naming W25 only. The $500K March 2025 pre-seed rests on a single aggregator (FundedIQ) with no investors named and no second source. YC page descriptions conflict (productivity tracker vs LLM evals). Founded year not stated by sources.
